results.title: UrbanStreet, Wingspan Development execute merger
results.description: UrbanStreet Group and Wingspan Development Group, which is the national development branch of the Nicholas Family of Companies, have completed a merger to accelerate their growth. Mount Prospect, Illinois-based Wingspan is set to transition its entire pipeline of multifamily and mixed-use developments to UrbanStreet so it can focus on expansions in commercial sectors. Schaumburg-based UrbanStreet will be tackling the multifamily development aspects of the combined companies, while Nicholas & Associates, the NFOC’s general contracting branch, will continue to construct multifamily projects that fall under the new merger across Illinois, Florida and Wisconsin, according to a press release. results.title: 1,750 Litres Of Ghee Worth ₹6.8 Lakh Seized In Indore, 18 Samples Sent For Lab Tests
results.description: Food safety officials in Indore seized around 1,750 litres of ghee worth ₹6.80 lakh from Maa Baglamukhi Enterprises in Scheme No. 51. The stock belonged to Gujarat-made Manthan and Shri Anand brands. Officials collected 18 samples from different batches for laboratory testing, with the seized stock to remain in custody until reports arrive.
